message.content: It’s hard to pick just one, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Parasite”** as the standout film of 2020. Directed by Bong Joon‑ho, it masterfully blends dark comedy, thriller, and social satire, earning the Palme d’Or at Cannes and becoming the first Korean-language film to win Best Picture at the Oscars. Its sharp storytelling, stellar performances, and timely commentary on class inequality made it a cultural touchstone that resonated worldwide.
